summary.text: Brenda Boatman is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Cynthia Borrego (D).
She previously ran for District 23 in 2018, when she lost the general election to incumbent Daymon Ely (D).
